title: Support and updates for digital products

sections.skill: Plan support and updates for a digital product

questions.prompt: Why is a digital product not "make once and forget"?

choices.text: Customers never have questions about software
Customers need support and the product needs updates
Digital products never have errors once launched
Devices and platforms never change over time

questions.correct_answer: Customers need support and the product needs updates
questions.intro: Digital products (apps, templates, online courses, software tools) are not "make once and forget." Customers need SUPPORT: answers when something does not work, clear instructions, and a way to contact you. Products also need UPDATES when devices, browsers or platforms change, and to fix bugs (errors). Budget time for support and updates, state what support is included (for example "email replies within 2 business days"), and keep a list of common questions to turn into a help page.

sections.skill: Owning a car, not just buying it

questions.prompt: Launching a digital product is like what?
questions.intro: Buying a car is not the end of the cost: it needs oil changes, repairs and new tires. A digital product is similar. Launching it is like buying the car; support and updates are the ongoing maintenance. Skip the maintenance and the car, or the product, eventually stops working for the people who rely on it.
